name: bistro
description: Restaurant ordering app and staff admin panel. Next.js web client, Node.js REST API, PostgreSQL.

scripts.//: dev and build compile @bistro/shared first. Its package main points at dist/, dist/ is gitignored, and nothing else builds it — so without this a fresh clone fails with 15 copies of 'Cannot resolve @bistro/shared'. The Dockerfiles and CI call the workspace scripts directly and build shared in their own step, so they do not go through these.
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bistro/shared && npm run dev -w @bistro/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bistro/shared && npm run build -w @bistro/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @bistro/shared && npm run build -w @bistro/api
